notes.title: UPDATE 1.5
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE 1.5[/b]

Added 4 more languages (French, German, Spanish, and Japanese). 
You can choose your language from the in-game settings menu.  

[img]https://ibb.co/KsQ7cZj[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug where game freezes after a cutscene 
- Added the "Super Girl" achievement
- Added the "All Endings" achievement
- Fixed the crashing after pressing the retry button
- Fixed collisions on the fire level climbing boxes  
- Added translations to the ending texts
- Changed the minimum requirements due to some hardwares failing to get constant 30 FPS (If the game goes below 30 FPS game slows down, hitches, and glitches)
